If all entry gates pass, create exactly one bounded complex-frequency/QNM successor; otherwise file typed missing-prerequisite work. Do not perform or claim BH-3 physics in this review.

body.forbid: no Conflux; no stability, QNM, ringdown, scattering, observational, or quantum claim in the review; no bypass of complex-frequency analyticity, asymptotic phase-space, or boundary well-posedness
activates: one bounded BH-3 complex-frequency pilot if and only if every readiness gate passes
body.resource_hint: Proof/readiness review only. Do not begin a QNM computation. Conflux remains disabled.
notes: Mathematical target: a dependency-complete definition of the exterior complex-frequency boundary-value problem and the claims it could support.
Candidate theorem: BH-3 vocabulary is admissible only after analytic continuation, asymptotic phase-space/current finiteness, and boundary well-posedness gates are separately proved.
Proof obligations: list and link every prerequisite, distinguish mode existence from stability and observed ringdown, and define independent numerical validation before any successor is created.
Counterexample strategy: each omitted prerequisite must have a concrete failure scenario that blocks the corresponding vocabulary.
Certificate boundary: this review establishes readiness or missing gates only; it establishes no QNM, stability, ringdown, scattering, or observational result.
